hooks.name: fix-sonar-issues-post-task-hook

action.prompt:
A spec task just completed. The hook context includes the task name and spec path. Your job is to fix Sonar violations ONLY in the files that were modified by this task.

## Step 1 — Identify modified files
Read the task entry from tasks.md (use spec_name from hook context) and extract the list of files mentioned under 'Files to modify'. These are the only files you should touch.

## Step 2 — Run getDiagnostics on modified files only
For each file identified in Step 1, run getDiagnostics on that specific file path to retrieve problems currently listed in the Problems panel. Do NOT scan the entire project or any files not modified by this task.

## Step 3 — Fix only reported problems
For each file that has diagnostics:
- Read the file
- Fix only the issues that getDiagnostics explicitly reported (by rule ID, line number, or message). Do not speculatively fix issues that are not listed.
- Do not change business logic or functionality.

## Step 4 — Verify
Re-run getDiagnostics on each fixed file to confirm the reported problems are resolved. Report what was fixed and what (if anything) remains.

hooks.description: After each spec task completes, runs getDiagnostics only on the files modified by that task and fixes the Sonar violations reported in the Problems panel for those files only.
